newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas slips in May on last day, others untrad.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas slips in May on last day, others untrad.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract saw only two trades on Tuesday morning, both in the front month May contract, which expires at the end of the afternoon session.
Both deals were struck at 10.60 pence a therm, down by 0.025 pence from Monday's close. Bids and offer on May later widened out, with a spread of 0.25 pence a therm by the close of the session.
The slight fall was against the expectations of some in the market, who had seen prices likely to rise in line with recent strength on the spot market.
